stem:
The dot plot shows the number of packages mailed by the last 20 customers at a post office.

Which statement best describes the data shown in the dot plot?

options.label: J
options.text: The peak of the data is at 10.

visual_elements: dot plot with 0 through 10 labeled on number line and dots stacked: 0 has 6 dots, 1 has 3 dots, 2 has 6 dots, 5 has 1 dot, 8 has 1 dot, 10 has 2 dots
